request:
Which methods of the Group class in src/click/core.py override a method that its base class Command (same file) defines itself under the same name? Count only methods written in the body of Command, not ones Command inherits; __init__ counts as an override. Give the symbol ID of the Group method.

Requested output columns: symbol_id (string).
explanation: Finds Group methods defined in src/click/core.py whose name matches a method of a class Command that is defined in the same file (Command's own symbol row), then filters to methods that are actually in Group's ancestry (ancestor is Command). This counts only overrides of methods defined in Command's body, not inherited ones.
